items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: I was so busy listening to Trane I was overlooking Cannonball. Then later on I started listening to Cannonball on YouTube and everything.

ctx.x: Yes. Well I’m glad you said that and I think the reason one of my favorite musicians has always been Cannonball Adderley, and boy, he had some spirit.

Oh shucks, I mean Cannonball, because for a while there what was so in me, I was so busy listening to Trane I was overlooking Cannonball. Then later on I started listening to Cannonball on YouTube and everything. I said oh my goodness, I mean Cannonball was playing but I was so busy listening to Trane and oh man, shoot. Cannonball and that group he had with his brother, oh man.
Have you been able to keep ownership over the years of your own music?
